cards.power: Weaponized FOMO - Target opponent must skip their next turn to draw cards they are not allowed to look at.
cards.lore: Go everywhere on the map. Prove to the machine that you have surveyed every inch of your own cage.

cards.power: Goalpost Shift - Move target opponent's victory token back three spaces.
cards.lore: Reach the end of the level. Your reward is a slightly harder level.

cards.power: Cognitive Loop - Force opponent to shuffle their hand into their deck and redraw the same number minus one.
cards.lore: Find an exit to the level. Spoilers: there is no outside.

cards.power: False Summit - Cancel an opponent's action just as it resolves.
cards.lore: Ascend to the top of a tower to fight a guy who could have just met you in the lobby.

cards.power: Panic Attack - Opponent must play their next card in 3 seconds or discard it.
cards.lore: Go that way and don't stop. The illusion of choice, accelerated.

cards.power: Scripted Collapse - Destroy all resource cards currently in play. Everyone starts running.
cards.lore: Run away from danger until you reach safety. Safety is a cutscene.

cards.power: Rising Sludge - Discard the bottom three cards of everyone's deck.
cards.lore: Climb up until you reach safety. Gravity is now a microtransaction.

cards.power: Arbitrary Roadblock - Target opponent cannot attack or advance until they sacrifice a high-value card.
cards.lore: You cannot pass until the developers finish coding the next zone.

cards.power: Sponge Mechanics - Absorb the next 3 attacks directed at you.
cards.lore: Defeat a challenging monster who exists solely to gatekeep your dopamine.

cards.power: Blood Lock - Opponent cannot draw new cards until they destroy one of their own items.
cards.lore: Kill all the monsters in an area. You are the janitor of death.

cards.power: Grindset - Play the same low-level attack three times in a row for triple damage.
cards.lore: Kill many of the same monster. Because repetitive labor is fun when it's violent!

cards.power: Macabre Fetch - Steal a random resource card from an opponent's hand.
cards.lore: Retrieve Random Drops for an NPC. The pinnacle of heroic fetch quests.

cards.power: Hitlist - Target a specific card in an opponent's deck. If drawn, it is instantly destroyed.
cards.lore: Kill everyone on a list of targets. A psychopath's grocery run.

cards.power: Momentum - For every card you played last turn, draw an extra card this turn.
cards.lore: Kill as many enemies as you can without getting hit. Perfect for your anxiety!

cards.power: System Update - Change the current rules of the game randomly for one round.
cards.lore: Defeat the computer who is controlling the game against you. The house always wins.

cards.power: Divide and Conquer - Force two opponents to discard a card of each other's choosing.
cards.lore: Defeat another player who is likewise trying to defeat you. Keep the plebs fighting each other.

cards.power: Suicidal AI - Attach this to an opponent. They must spend one action per turn protecting it, or lose 5 points.
cards.lore: Help a weaker ally navigate a dangerous area. The ultimate test of your patience.

cards.power: Guilt Trip - Opponent cannot play attack cards while you have fewer cards in your hand.
cards.lore: Save all the allies in distress. A hoarding pathology disguised as altruism.

cards.power: Attrition - Neither you nor your opponent can draw new cards for 2 turns.
cards.lore: Survive by not letting the enemy win. Stand in this circle until we say you can leave.

cards.power: Damsel Tax - Steal an opponent's highest-value card and hide it under this card until they defeat it.
cards.lore: Rescue someone who's been kidnapped. Again. Try better locks next time.

cards.power: Busywork - Opponent must discard two cards to draw one card.
cards.lore: Retrieve one or more Plot Coupons for an NPC. You are an intern with a sword.

cards.power: Red Tape - Swap hands with an opponent, then randomly swap one card back.
cards.lore: Trade items for items until finally obtaining the one you want. Bureaucracy as gameplay.

cards.power: Fragile Cargo - Your next attack deals double damage, but if you take any damage before your next turn, you lose a turn.
cards.lore: Overcome obstacles to deliver Plot Coupons to an NPC. Postmates, but with dragons.

cards.power: Gatekeeper - Opponent cannot play their strongest card until they play three weak cards first.
cards.lore: Collect three ancient artifacts to open the door. The narrative equivalent of a punch card.

cards.power: Compulsive Capture - Take control of an opponent's weakest card permanently.
cards.lore: Collect all the items or Live Items. Turning wildlife preservation into a hostage situation.

cards.power: Pathing Error - Opponent's cards are played on the wrong targets this turn.
cards.lore: Herd animals into an area. Because AI pathfinding is a joke we play on you.

cards.power: Cat Herding - Opponent must reveal their hand and shuffle it back into their deck.
cards.lore: Gather a group of NPCs together. Wrangling digital toddlers.

cards.power: Inventory Bite - Discard a resource. It bites you; take 1 damage.
cards.lore: Stuffing living creatures into your infinite pocket. Don't think about the ethics.

cards.power: Bribed Loyalty - Sacrifice an item card to draw two extra cards.
cards.lore: Earn your ally's favor. Friendship is transactional.

cards.power: Trauma Dump - Opponent must skip their turn to listen to your backstory.
cards.lore: Complete your ally's personal goal so they don't betray you at the finale.

cards.power: Simulated Love - Force an opponent's card to fight for you for one round.
cards.lore: Earn your ally's love. Select dialogue option C to receive affection.

cards.power: Shiny Distraction - Negate all damage this turn, but your cards look absolutely ridiculous.
cards.lore: A shiny hat to validate your hundred hours of meaningless grinding.

cards.power: Sliding Blocks - Rearrange the order of the top 5 cards of any deck.
cards.lore: Solve a puzzle. Because the ancient architect loved pushing ice blocks around.

cards.power: Distraction Game - Both players must roll a die; highest roll steals a card from the lowest.
cards.lore: Play a smaller game with its own rules. Pacing is a myth.

cards.power: Goal Fragmentation - Change the win condition of the game for 2 turns.
cards.lore: Why save the world when you could be taking photos of frogs?

cards.power: Deus Ex Machina - If you hold this card for 5 consecutive turns without playing it, you win the game.
cards.lore: Reaching the most important objective. Press X to end the simulation.

cards.power: Sunk Cost Fallacy - Opponent cannot win unless their hand is completely empty.
cards.lore: Don't miss any optional objectives. Your digital grave requires all the shiny trinkets.

cards.power: Harsh Grading - If opponent's attack doesn't defeat a card instantly, the attack is negated.
cards.lore: Play the game as well as possible. The machine judges your worth.

cards.power: Lore Dump - Reveal your entire hand to the opponent; if you have a pair, double your attack points.
cards.lore: Collect all 500 hidden rocks to learn the true, disappointing lore.

cards.power: Hollow Victory - Gain 10 points, but you cannot attack on your next turn.
cards.lore: An achievement for your profile that literally nobody else cares about.

cards.power: Self-Sabotage - Play with your hand facing outward to the opponent, but your attacks do +2 damage.
cards.lore: Complete the game with optional restrictions. Because normal misery wasn't enough.

cards.power: Blindfolded - Draw cards blindly from the bottom of your deck.
cards.lore: Completes the game with your own restrictions. Stockholm Syndrome: Expert Edition.

cards.power: Elixir Hoarder - Opponent cannot use item cards for 3 turns.
cards.lore: Don't use your items. Hoard the mega-elixirs until the credits roll.

cards.power: Confiscated Inventory - All players must discard their currently equipped items.
cards.lore: Don't use weapons or equipment. A sudden, arbitrary strip search by the developers.

cards.power: Sequence Break - Skip your opponent's next turn.
cards.lore: Complete objectives as quickly as possible. Skip the story, break the physics.

cards.power: Instant Fail - If opponent plays a loud (attack) card, their turn instantly ends.
cards.lore: Don't let enemies notice you. An instant fail state for stepping on a twig.

cards.power: Ticking Clock - Opponent has exactly 10 seconds to complete their entire turn.
cards.lore: Complete objectives before time runs out. Artificial stress for artificial stakes.

cards.power: Glass Cannon - If you take any damage, discard your entire hand.
cards.lore: Don't get hurt. One microscopic pixel of a hitbox ruins five hours of work.

cards.power: Bait and Switch - Play a card face down. When opponent attacks it, it explodes for 3 damage.
cards.lore: Your real goal is to destroy the facility. The reward was bait.

cards.power: Moved Goalpost - Move an opponent's target to a different card just as they attack.
cards.lore: Finding and saving the princess. Except your reward is a fungal hallucination.

cards.power: Tunnel Vision - Opponent can only play resource cards this turn; no attacks.
cards.lore: Goals players become too dependent on, forgetting how to actually play.

cards.power: Swarm Mechanics - Fill your opponent's hand with useless 0-point cards.
cards.lore: Players can set their own goals, such as having 100 babies. You are the architect of your own hell.

cards.power: High Score - Gain 100 meaningless points. They do nothing, but you feel great.
cards.lore: Completing an objective to watch a digital integer increase. Dopamine achieved.

cards.power: Level Up - Discard 5 cards to increase your base attack by 1.
cards.lore: Repeat the same action until the bar is full. Welcome to middle management.

cards.power: Inflation - All cards cost double to play this turn.
cards.lore: A mechanic designed purely to delete the wealth you spent 40 hours accumulating.

cards.power: Game Over - Flip the table. (Or, in gameplay: End the match immediately [Rest vom GW-Logo verdeckt])
cards.lore: Don't allow a specific character to be killed. Good thing you're not the hero.
